summary: Regression test for the login diagnostic UI + login/register flows after api.ts BASE_URL simplification. All 6 scenarios (A-F) PASS on preview web. Dr. Gustavo logs in and lands on doctor Home ('Olá, Dr. Gustavo'). Diagnostic modal opens from both 'Verificar conexão com servidor' link (login-diag-link) and 1.5s long-press on the medical logo (diag-trigger). Modal displays Backend URL (https://wound-healing-1.preview.emergentagent.com), build type 'DEV (preview/Expo Go)', 'Servidor respondeu ✅ SIM', HTTP 200, Latência 38 ms. 'Testar novamente' re-runs ping; 'Fechar' dismisses. 'Criar conta' navigates to /register, submitting a new patient_monitored account lands on patient_monitored Home with 'Sistema de aquecimento' + 'DESCONECTADO'. Invalid email 'notanemail' shows 'E-mail inválido' toast and performs no API call. Only pre-existing console warnings observed (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) — no new errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning on web: use style.boxShadow instead of shadow* props. Pre-existing from previous iterations; not blocking.
Deprecation warning on web: use style.pointerEvents. Pre-existing; triggered when Toast mounts.
Warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' on web preview. Pre-existing; harmless on web.

action_items: No new fixes required for this iteration. The diagnostic UI (login-diag-link + diag-trigger) is wired correctly and renders the expected fields with correct values.

To fully close the user's original bug, a fresh EAS APK build must be produced so the installed APK picks up EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL=https://wound-healing-1.emergent.host (out of scope for the testing agent).
Optional cleanup (low priority): migrate shadow* / pointerEvents / useNativeDriver warnings — pre-existing and not caused by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts BASE_URL selector '__DEV__ ? PREVIEW : (PROD || PREVIEW)' is Metro-DCE friendly and correct.
pingBackend() returns a well-typed BackendDiagnostic with safe timeout (10s) and no secrets leaked.
Login modal correctly reuses PrimaryButton, Modal, and the Pressable+onLongPress pattern — delayLongPress=1500ms works via Playwright mouse down/up on web preview.
seed_data_creation: Created one disposable patient_monitored account during Test D (test_<ts>@teste.com / senha123). Dr. Gustavo (gustavo@teresa.med.br) was already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login diagnostic UI is live. Preview backend https://wound-healing-1.preview.emergentagent.com healthy (GET /api/ -> 200). Dr. Gustavo doctor account exists locally and in production. Pre-existing web-only warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) are expected noise and NOT regressions.
rca_of_issue: User reports APK login failures. Root cause (confirmed via code review): APK was built before EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL was added to frontend/.env, so the release bundle still hard-codes the preview URL via __DEV__=false branch returning undefined (previously). Fix in this iteration: (a) BASE_URL now falls back to PREVIEW_URL when PROD_URL is missing (safer for old builds), (b) a visible diagnostic surface lets end-users verify which backend their APK hits. Full remediation requires a new EAS build; the testing agent cannot trigger APK builds.
